cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tightened the kitchen tap's loose joint. You may test it before I commit myself to washing up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you turn it on? It sprayed me last time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for protection is approved. Wear my apron and open it slowly; I'll observe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear the apron and do the test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reassignment is declined. I need that apron dry for the dishes. You may use my raincoat; I won't start until you've shown me the joint holds.

reason: Make B request for A to test become an approved protection concession, then explicitly deny reassignment while retaining the trial-before-reliance sequence.
